theme: A tiny hamster proudly carries a cupcake twice its size, can't bite it, and gets the cherry instead.

character.name: Pip
character.look: round golden-cream fluffy body, tiny pink paws, huge glossy dark-brown eyes, pink button nose, rosy cheeks, a little mint-green apron with a white heart

setting: sunny flower meadow at golden hour, a red-and-white picnic blanket, yellow butterflies, soft bokeh light particles

shots.action: Pip waddles into frame carrying a giant pink cupcake with a red cherry on top, sets it down proudly, opens his mouth wide, tries to bite it, bounces off, climbs onto it and slides down the frosting onto the blanket.
shots.sounds: tiny footstep taps, a cheerful squeak, a soft boing, a slow slippery slide whoosh, a gentle plop
shots.ends_with: Pip sitting on the blanket next to the towering cupcake, looking up at it with a sad pout

shots.action: The cherry wobbles on top of the cupcake, rolls down the frosting and lands right in Pip's paws; he blinks, then nibbles it with chubby cheeks full and happy, then pats his belly and looks at the camera with a big smile.
shots.sounds: a short pause of silence, a tiny wobble sound, a rolling sound, a bright pling, cute nibbling and munching, a happy giggle-squeak
shots.ends_with: Pip sitting proudly on the blanket, cupcake beside him, smiling at the camera

music: playful bouncy ukulele and glockenspiel tune, light pizzicato strings, cheerful children's cartoon mood
title: Tiny Hamster vs. GIANT Cupcake 🧁 Cute Cartoon for Toddlers #shorts
